notes: «وَ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» opens the report with the Imam's words and no transmitter; the chain that follows («رَوَى ذَلِكَ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ ... عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ») ends at Abu Ja'far, so it is unclear whether Ali is the last link (rule 6); he is written as a single link only on the bare opening
«وَ رَوَاهُ اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant
